column1: # Declares desired infected-type weights (NOT global zombie count).
# Each key MUST be defined in 3781448194 sandbox-options.txt on VPS.
# Values are spawn weights, not percentages if other types are enabled.
# Relative TLOU weights = Runner 56%, Stalker 33%, Clicker 11%, Bloater 0%.
# Forge vanilla ZF_Zomboid must also be disabled if this fork supports it.
# Prefer aggressive movement into dark interiors if actual MP build supports.
